arguments.explanation: Flags every transaction whose time falls between 01:00 and 04:59 (inclusive), on any day.
assumptions: The time is read from the transaction's date column exactly as stored. No time zone conversion is applied.
The window covers any timestamp from 01:00:00 through 04:59:59, so it includes every minute up to and including 04:59.
No other conditions are added, such as amount, transaction type or card type.
